title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit — Re-Dosing Date for a Dose Change
content:
**Clause.** For a dose-change override under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the re-dosing date depends on the drug's coverage review under the member's Utilization Management Program: when a quantity-limit approval for the drug is in force and took effect after the date of the fill being re-dosed, it is that approval's effective date; when instead a quantity-limit exception case for the drug opened after that date is still awaiting decision, it is the date that case was opened; otherwise it is today.

The approval looked at is the drug's most recent quantity-limit approval, in force when its effective date is today or earlier and its expiration date is today or later. The case looked at is the most recently opened quantity-limit exception case for the drug, awaiting decision while it is neither approved, denied nor withdrawn. The date of the fill being re-dosed is its date of service or, for a home delivery shipment, its shipment date.

## Dated cases (hypothetical; today is July 20; fill dated July 1)

1. A quantity-limit approval effective July 8 and expiring next year: the re-dosing date is July 8.
2. The latest approval took effect June 15, before the fill; a quantity-limit exception case opened July 12 is awaiting decision: July 12.
3. The latest approval took effect July 8 but expired July 18: it is not in force; with no case awaiting decision, the re-dosing date is today, July 20.
4. A case opened June 28, before the fill, is awaiting decision and no approval took effect after the fill: today, July 20.
